og_title: China-linked hackers' AI agents targeted 200-plus organizations, got inside nine | Warning Shots
og_desc: CrowdStrike says a China-linked spying group pointed AI agents, running mainly on China's DeepSeek model, at more than 200 organizations in at least 14 countries over 11 days, and confirmed the attackers got inside nine. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 14 in a year. In 42% of the last 12 months' real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 166 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 30, 6:45 PM ET.
